facts.business: Sealmac India Limited is engaged in manufacturing and trading activities with significant inventory and trade receivables, and has a joint venture entity Sealtech Seals Repairs and Maintenance LLC.

auditor.name: M/s. R R Shah & Associates, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: The Company has not developed and implemented any risk management policy as the risk threatening the business activity carried out by the Company during the year are minimal.
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions, those were entered into during the Financial Year under review, were on an arm's length basis, and in the ordinary course of business and are in compliance with the applicable provisions of the Act and the Listing Regulations. All Related Party Transactions are placed before the Audit Committee for prior approval. Prior omnibus approval of the Audit Committee is obtained wherever required for the transactions which are repetitive in nature or when the need for these transactions cannot be foreseen in advance. None of the transactions entered into with Related Parties fall under the scope of Section 188(1) of the Act.
